_note: Illustrative values of the 4 parameters Spring passes to ApiHitInterceptor.afterCompletion for a public GET /api/courses. These are Java objects, shown as JSON; real objects have more fields. /api/admin/** never reaches the interceptor.

_notes: bestMatchingPattern is what the interceptor reads via HandlerMapping.BEST_MATCHING_PATTERN_ATTRIBUTE
for /api/courses/3 it would be "/api/courses/{id}" and uriTemplateVariables would be {"id": "3"}
remoteAddr is Cloudflare's address; the visitor's real IP is in the CF-Connecting-IP header
committed: true means the response is already sent, so afterCompletion can't change it
this is why `handler instanceof HandlerMethod` is true; an unknown URL gets the static resource handler instead and the interceptor returns early

_ex_note: null because the request succeeded; even an ApiException (e.g. 404) is usually already turned into an error response, so ex stays null and response.status shows the error

result._note: what the interceptor actually uses from all of the above, and the row it writes
